summary: @or-sdk/event-manager preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook running setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ to the install location, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle using string-array rotation obfuscation with hex-named identifiers. The advertised purpose of the package is an EventManager SDK, which has no legitimate need to pull a second language runtime and execute a large opaque bundle during npm install. setup.mjs itself uses hex-named identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e,...), and the payload carries a cover file name (math_init.js) that does not correspond to any event-manager functionality. Executing the payload under a freshly downloaded Bun binary rather than Node bypasses tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code. The result is attacker-controlled code execution on the installer host at npm install time via an opaque, alternate-runtime-executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
